comments.verdict_missing: **@{agent}** ended its run in **{stage}** without a `verdict.md` that reads, so the task is blocked here.
comments.verdict_undelivered: **@{agent}** ended its run in **{stage}**, but its verdict did not reach Thulu: the runner could not upload all of the run's output (see the run's warning). The task is blocked here.
comments.flow_flags_invalid: The refinement's `flags.yaml` has a `surface` this board cannot use: {values}. Values are short ids (`ui`, `perf`, `migration`, `auth`, `api`), at most {max}. Conditional stages still run as before.
comments.flow_flags_from_diff: The branch changes UI files ({files}) though the spec does not mark `ui`. The task now has `ui`, so **{stage}** runs.
comments.flow_flags_diff_unreadable: Could not read the branch diff ({err}), so **{stage}** runs even though the spec does not mark `ui`.
comments.stage_skipped: Skipped **{stage}**: it runs only for {required}, and the surface of this task is {flags}.
comments.resources_released: **{stage}** freed the task's sandbox and worktrees: the branch is merged, and this stage works against the remote.
comments.kick_back_released: The task had to go back from **{stage}** ({source}), but this stage already freed the worktree and the branch is merged. It stays here, blocked: open a new task for the fix.
comments.locked_tests_refused: `locked-tests.txt` lists paths outside the repository, ignored: {paths}

comments.auditor_outlived: The auditor of **{agent}** in **{stage}** finished after the task moved to **{now}**. Its verdict did not apply.
comments.run_outlived_event: {agent} finished in {stage} after the task moved to {now}; its result did not apply
comments.stage_launch_deferred: **{agent}** waits in **{stage}**: the agent of **{busy}** still works on the task. It starts on its own when that run ends.
